description: The legacy task bench tasks (benchmarks/banco.py), translated to English.

tasks.name: booking
tasks.request: Bookings API for a class with a single seat. Two users can book at the same time: two bookings must never be assigned to the same seat. Node.js.

tasks.name: payment
tasks.request: POST /payments endpoint with orderId and amount, an Idempotency-Key and no double charge under concurrent retries. Node.js.

tasks.name: stock
tasks.request: Reserve stock of a product without overselling when simultaneous orders arrive. Node.js.

tasks.name: rate_limit
tasks.request: Per-user rate limiter with a token bucket, safe under concurrent requests. Node.js.

tasks.name: queue
tasks.request: Queue consumer that never applies the same message twice even if it is redelivered. Node.js.
